They then used insecure Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) settings to obtain login certificates for privileged accounts, including one for a domain controller. Microsoft said

items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a new Windows infostealer malware called VOLTA-AUTODOXER (aka VOLTA) that makes use of a large language model (LLM) to rank a victim's stolen data by their monetization value. Like other typical stealer families, VOLTA is equipped to harvest passwords and co

items.summary: A critical flaw in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud let an attacker log in as a trusted client without holding that client's private key. To do it, the attacker had to reach their HTTPS API over the network and have the trusted client's public certificate. Once in, the attacker would act as that clien

The code had replaced a page-speed script that the site loaded from an outside company. Polymarket says it is refunding about $2.7 million to

items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of what has been described as a "highly sophisticated infection chain" targeting government organizations in Asia. The activity, detailed by Kaspersky this week, targeted a custom Windows 10 build used exclusively by government entities in Asia and in

items.title: Chainalysis Confirms Intrusion Into Internal Tools and Exposure of Customer Identity Data
items.summary: American blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis said it was the target of a cybersecurity incident in which an external actor accessed non-sensitive customer data. However, the company noted that the breach did not result in unauthorized access to its investigation content, authentication credentials,

items.title: CVE-2026-118527 · Ivanti Connect Secure: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
items.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

items.title: CVE-2026-111357 · Ivanti Connect Secure: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
items.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

items.title: CVE-2026-97229 · GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
items.summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

items.title: CVE-2026-76418 · Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

items.title: CVE-2026-41709 · Broadcom VMware ESX: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
items.summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

items.title: CVE-2026-46300 · Linux Kernel: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
items.summary: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-48356 · Adobe Commerce and Magento: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
items.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

items.title: CVE-2026-111497 · Google Brotli: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
items.summary: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

items.title: CVE-2026-109618 · PHP Group PHP: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
items.summary: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-109619 · PHP Group PHP: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
items.summary: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-114625 · Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-110447 · Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

items.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
items.summary: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaw

items.title: CVE-2026-106931 · EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

items.title: CVE-2026-96656 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

items.title: CVE-2026-96655 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

items.title: CVE-2026-96654 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

items.title: CVE-2026-96652 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

items.title: CVE-2026-110936 · Siemens Software Center: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
items.summary: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

items.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
items.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources c

items.title: CVE-2026-102764 · BeyondTrust Remote Support: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
items.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2025-61624 · Fortinet Multiple Products: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-21589 · Atlassian Multiple Products: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
items.summary: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

items.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
items.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial res

items.title: CVE-2026-105134 · Ahsay AhsayCBS: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

items.title: CVE-2026-76519 · Cisco Secure Email Gateway: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

items.title: CVE-2026-105133 · Ahsay AhsayCBS: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

items.title: CVE-2026-0322 · Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

items.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
items.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.

items.title: CVE-2026-104935 · Ivanti Connect Secure: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
items.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-96951 · Microsoft Windows: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

items.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
items.summary: Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) on Thursday arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSec

items.title: CVE-2015-5477 · ISC BIND:  ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
items.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

items.title: CVE-2016-3081 · Apache Struts: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2023-22894 · Strapi Strapi: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
items.summary: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2021-3199 · ONLYOFFICE Docs: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2015-3306 · ProFTPD ProFTPD: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
items.summary: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

items.title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
items.summary: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang. KrebsOnSecurity has learned that the suspect, who uses the hacker handle "Rey," was

items.title: CVE-2026-88779 · Citrix NetScaler: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
items.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-102490 · Zammad GmbH Zammad: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
items.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

items.title: CVE-2026-102489 · Zammad GmbH Zammad: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
items.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

items.title: CVE-2026-104286 · Fortinet FortiMail: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-76504 · Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

items.title: CVE-2026-86950 · Apple Multiple Products: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
items.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.
